req.prompt:
Maximum party policy: no booking may be for more than 8 people, whatever the table. Add it to src/booking/commands/create_booking.rs and src/web/bookings/failures.rs, and make sure the web refuses such a booking; add a test.

Keep cargo test and cargo clippy (-D warnings) passing. Do not run anything; just edit. No new comments. Reply with one line saying what you changed.

result: I added an 8-person cap: `CreateBooking` now returns a new `PartyOverPolicyLimit` failure for any larger party, whatever the table, and `failures.rs` maps it to 422. I added tests in `create_booking.rs` and `routes.rs` (a 9-person booking on a 20-seat table is refused). I haven't run `cargo test` or `cargo clippy`, as you asked.
